components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single cobalt action used to start the agent workflow.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 15px; color: var(--surface); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 650 0.82rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--accent-pressed); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-action:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.45; transform: none; }

components.css: .ds-quiet-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 9px; color: var(--accent); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; font: 650 0.72rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-quiet-action:hover { background: #eaf3fc; } .ds-quiet-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-quiet-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A mist-gray switcher for source modes and publishing channels.
components.css: .ds-segmented { width: fit-content; display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface-muted); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--secondary); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; font: 600 0.75rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-segmented button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-segmented button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-segmented button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); }

components.name: Source Input
components.description: The large borderless source field that anchors the workflow.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-source-input" aria-label="Topic source" placeholder="What should your content team write about?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-source-input { width: 100%; min-height: 142px; padding: 24px 10px 18px; resize: vertical; color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--accent); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; outline: 0; font: 400 1.3rem/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-source-input::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary); opacity: 1; } .ds-source-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-composer { overflow: hidden; padding: 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-composer-label { width: fit-content; padding: 5px 9px; color: var(--secondary); background: var(--surface-muted); border-radius: 7px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-composer-field { min-height: 100px; padding: 24px 10px 18px; color: var(--tertiary); font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-composer-footer { min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 0 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--secondary); border-top: 1px solid #e8e8eb; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-composer-footer strong { padding: 10px 15px; color: var(--surface); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.82rem; }

components.name: Connected Agent Rail
components.description: The signature shared rail that transfers one active cobalt state across five specialists.
components.html:
1. ✓ScoutResearch · Done
  2. ✦MuseStrategy · Working
  3. ✎ScribeChannel copy · Waiting
components.css: .ds-agent-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--tertiary); list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-agent-rail li { position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 82px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr); align-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 14px 12px; } .ds-agent-rail li + li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 22px; bottom: 22px; width: 1px; background: var(--line); } .ds-agent-symbol { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--secondary); background: #e8e8ec; border-radius: 10px; transition: color 220ms ease-out, background 220ms ease-out, transform 220ms ease-out, box-shadow 220ms ease-out; } .ds-agent-rail strong, .ds-agent-rail small { display: block; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-agent-rail strong { color: var(--secondary); font-size: 0.77rem; } .ds-agent-rail small { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 0.65rem; } .ds-agent-rail .is-working .ds-agent-symbol { color: var(--surface); background: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(0, 113, 227, 0.22); } .ds-agent-rail .is-working strong, .ds-agent-rail .is-working small { color: var(--accent); } .ds-agent-rail .is-done .ds-agent-symbol { color: var(--success); background: #e5f4e8; } .ds-agent-rail .is-done strong { color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
Relay is a focused creative work surface: cool, precise, and quietly capable. The source is always the center of gravity, while status, agent activity, and publishing tools recede until they are needed. The interface should feel like a well-resolved native productivity tool rather than a dashboard or a marketing site.

Its Apple-influenced restraint comes from system typography, cool-white tonal layers, graphite text, familiar control geometry, and one carefully rationed cobalt accent. Ambient depth separates the two primary working surfaces; thin dividers organize everything else. Motion communicates state transfer and materialization, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-white canvas with crisp white working surfaces and mist-gray control groups.
Source-first hierarchy with large, tightly set graphite display type.
Restrained cobalt reserved for selection, progress, focus, and primary action.
A connected five-agent handoff rail instead of independent dashboard cards.
Functional translucency confined to the sticky top bar.
Immediate pressed feedback and short, restrained state transitions.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt only where the interface is selected, progressing, focused, or actionable; rarity preserves its meaning.

rules.name: The Cool Field Rule
rules.body: Keep major backgrounds within the cool-white and mist-gray family so content remains the visual artifact.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the native sans stack everywhere; do not introduce a display face or monospace accent.

rules.name: The Tight-Then-Open Rule
rules.body: Headlines use tight tracking and compact line-height, while reading copy uses generous leading.

rules.name: The One-Column Rule
rules.body: Extend the centered workspace before adding parallel columns; hierarchy comes from sequence, not dashboard density.

rules.name: The Working-Surface Rule
rules.body: Ambient elevation belongs only to the composer and generated-output surface; ordinary groups remain flat and separated by tone or hairlines.

rules.name: The Functional Glass Rule
rules.body: Translucency is navigation context, never decorative card material.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner controls must be visibly tighter than the surface that contains them.

dos: Do keep each screen source-first, with one obvious primary action and a calm sequential reading order.
Do use Relay Cobalt only for selected, actionable, focused, or live-progress states.
Do preserve 44px touch targets for segmented controls and output actions on narrow screens.
Do support reduced motion, reduced transparency, and increased contrast without changing information hierarchy.
Do use thin dividers and tonal layers for ordinary grouping; reserve ambient shadows for primary working surfaces.
donts: Don't add a sidebar dashboard, fake navigation, metric tiles, or independent cards for each agent.
Don't turn the concise workspace heading into oversized marketing-hero chrome.
Don't stack translucent or glassy cards; translucency belongs only to the sticky top bar.
Don't introduce extra accent hues, gradients, decorative imagery, or a secondary typeface.
Don't animate for spectacle; motion should communicate pressed feedback, handoff progress, or result arrival.
